biotools.summary: SARST2 is a high-throughput protein structure alignment algorithm that integrates primary, secondary, and tertiary structural features with evolutionary statistics. It significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in accuracy and speed, enabling rapid database searches even on personal computers.
